facts.fact: 麦克杜格尔认出信上的“魔鬼”是七晷区的达米安·辛克莱。
facts.anchor: The Devil of Seven Dials. Damien Sinclair.

facts.fact: 麦克杜格尔说辛克莱杀过的人比瘟疫还多。
facts.anchor: He’s killed more people than the plague.

facts.fact: 麦克杜格尔说七晷区几乎所有人都替辛克莱办事。
facts.anchor: He has every man in the Seven Dials working for him

facts.fact: 辛西娅听见哈姆雷特在脑中回话。
facts.anchor: I’m a fox. I can do whatever I please.

facts.fact: 哈姆雷特说能通动物的地巫很少，连罗温也做不到。
facts.anchor: Few earthwitches can communicate with animals.

facts.fact: 麦克杜格尔认为休伯特若欠辛克莱的钱未还，辛克莱就是头号嫌疑人。
facts.anchor: if Hubert owed Sinclair money and did no’ repay his debt

facts.fact: 麦克杜格尔宣布辛西娅不再是嫌疑人。
facts.anchor: You are no’ a suspect, Lady Burrows.

facts.fact: 辛西娅用无声辱骂试探，确认海伦娜读不到她的念头。
